findings.what: Whether Q1 turns on depends on which part is fitted. Q1 has no part number, so it is bounded by assumed corners; at the corner generic_pmos_sot_corner_low_vth it conducts with |VGS| = 2.48 V, below the 3.00 V maximum VGS(th) of its class, so a part nearer generic_pmos_sot_corner_high_vth is not guaranteed to turn on: put the MPN on Q1 to remove this assumption, or drive its gate to at least 4.50 V
findings.why: The board names this transistor only by its class, with no part number, so its gate threshold is anywhere in the class's range. The gate is driven to a voltage inside that range: a low-threshold part turns on, a high-threshold one may stay off, and the circuit behaves differently depending on which one the assembler fits.
findings.fix: Put the manufacturer part number on the transistor so its real threshold is checked, or drive the gate further (a level shifter or a higher gate supply), or pick a logic-level part rated at this drive.

assumptions.statement: Q1 is judged at every assumed corner (generic_pmos_sot_corner_high_vth, generic_pmos_sot_corner_low_vth), not at one stand-in.
assumptions.because: Nothing on the board names the part Q1 is, only its class, so the checks judged the board with it at each assumed corner the card lists (generic_pmos_sot_corner_high_vth, generic_pmos_sot_corner_low_vth).
assumptions.consequence: A result for Q1 holds for a part inside those corners; a fitted part outside them (a threshold or on-resistance the class bounds do not cover) is not judged.
assumptions.replacement: Put the manufacturer part number on Q1 (its value or an MPN field) so the run binds that part.

assumptions.statement: Q1 (Q_PMOS_GSD) was produced at reduced fidelity.
assumptions.because: It came from the generic fallback model 'generic_pmos_sot_corner_high_vth', whose ratings and device parameters are estimates for the package class rather than values from any datasheet, not from the primary path.
assumptions.consequence: Numbers for Q1 (Q_PMOS_GSD) are indicative: the mechanism that produced them is documented as less accurate than the primary path.
assumptions.replacement: Add a model entry matching the part (value_re or mpn_re), or put the manufacturer part number on the component.

assumptions.statement: Q1 (Q_PMOS_GSD) is modelled only in part.
assumptions.because: The board names only a P-channel MOSFET class, no part number: simulated at ASSUMED corners (|VGS(th)| 0.4 to 3.0 V, RDS(on) from the strongest to the weakest SOT-class small-signal package part this library carries), not any datasheet; hauksbee-ci passes it only if every corner passes; put the manufacturer part number on the component to replace it.
assumptions.consequence: Q1 (Q_PMOS_GSD) counts as a resolved part, so nothing else on this report flags it, but any result that depends on the unmodelled part of it is not evidence.
assumptions.replacement: Model the rest of the part, or treat results that depend on it as unanswered.
